entities.name: Louise de Coligny
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Louise de Coligny was a princess consort of Orange as the fourth and last wife of William the Silent. She was the daughter of Gaspard de Coligny, seigneur de Châtillon, and Charlotte de Laval.
